about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Focused on Precision Manufacturing, Building Quality Foundation
about.description1: We are a professional precision hardware parts manufacturing company established in 2004, with 20 years of industry experience. Our facility covers 10,000 square meters, equipped with advanced CNC machining centers, precision lathes, milling machines, and various inspection equipment.
about.description2: We serve multiple industries including automotive, aerospace, medical devices, and electronics. Our products are exported to over 30 countries across Europe, America, and Japan. We adhere to the principle of 'Excellence and Quality First', providing high-precision, high-quality parts machining services.
